features.title: CLI: projectbrain login + index (code is indexed locally, only metadata is uploaded)

acceptance.check: The per-token index rate limit (60 requests/min) holds across server instances: 30 requests on one instance and 31 on a fresh one with the same database, the 61st returns 429.

A project makes at most AI_CALLS_PER_PROJECT_PER_DAY AI calls per UTC day (default 2,000), also with parallel summarize requests; over it summarize returns budgetExhausted with resumesAt (next UTC midnight) and the CLI prints that summaries wait until then.
A file deleted locally is removed with its symbols on the next `projectbrain index`, which prints 'N changed, M unchanged, K deleted'; another project's files are untouched.
The CLI never sends the token over plain http to a non-local host (login refuses it, exit 2) and never follows a redirect.
Uploaded paths with control characters are rejected with 400, and secrets in any symbol name or signature (components and routes) are stored masked.
`pnpm --filter @brain/cli build` produces a runnable `projectbrain` bin: `login` reads the token from stdin and `index` uploads metadata, run as a separate process.
